tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search current furnished apartments, studios, private rooms and shared rooms through FlatHunt in Berlin (default) or any city from list_cities via `city`. Supports price, size, rooms, bedrooms, canonical area ids (Berlin) or nearby coordinates, availability dates, capacity, deposit, providers, ameni

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Get detailed information about a single FlatHunt listing by its numeric id (any city). Returns its description, amenities, rental-policy flags, capacity, stay terms, utilities, nearby distances, media, provider and tracking URLs. Availability and provider terms may change.

tools.name: compare_listings
tools.description: Return normalized detail fields for 2–10 FlatHunt listings by numeric id in one read-only response. Includes prices, location, amenities, rental-policy flags, capacity, description, utilities, nearby distances, provider and tracking URLs for side-by-side comparison.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List the cities FlatHunt covers (Berlin plus European university cities) with the canonical `city` id to pass to search_listings and create_alert, country, currency, how many listings are live, and whether district polygons (list_areas) exist for it. Berlin is the default city: omit `city` for Berli

tools.name: list_areas
tools.description: List district polygons (Berlin: Bezirke and Ortsteile) with canonical FlatHunt ids for the `areas` filter. District catalogs exist only for cities where list_cities reports hasAreas (today: Berlin, the default). For other cities search by city, post code or lat/lng/radiusKm. Returns id, name, slug,

tools.name: render_listings_widget
tools.description: Return UI-ready cards and an interactive MCP Apps gallery for 1–10 FlatHunt listing ids. The tool refreshes current listing data and displays images, provider, price, availability and listing actions. Optional alertCriteria adds a saved-search control for the represented filters.

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description: List the current user's saved search alerts on FlatHunt, including each alert's numeric id, name and creation time when available. Requires alerts.read.

tools.name: create_alert
tools.description: Create a saved search alert so FlatHunt notifies the user about new matching listings in the chosen city (Berlin unless `city` is set). Accepts housing, price, size, rooms, availability, canonical area ids, amenity and rental-policy filters. Email notifications are enabled by default; Telegram too w

tools.name: delete_alert
tools.description: Delete one or more of the current user's saved search alerts by numeric id. This is destructive and cannot be undone. Accepts 1–10 ids per call and requires alerts.write.

tools.name: list_saved_listings
tools.description: List the current user's saved (favorited) FlatHunt listings. Requires the favorites.read scope.

tools.name: save_listing
tools.description: Save (favorite) a FlatHunt listing for the current user by its numeric id. Requires the favorites.write scope. Ownership and duplicate handling are enforced by FlatHunt.

tools.name: remove_saved_listing
tools.description: Remove a listing from the current user's saved (favorited) listings by its numeric id. Requires the favorites.write scope.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_listing, compare_listings, list_areas, create_alert · Private data: search_listings · Public sink: list_areas, create_alert · Destructive: delete_alert, remove_saved_listing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_listing, compare_listings, list_areas, create_alert · Private data: search_listings · Public sink: list_areas, create_alert · Destructive: delete_alert, remove_saved_listing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_listings" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
